10xteam-10xteam:ashbyhq:7b2fbf6c-354e-49.description: Updated: 07 July 2026 Freelance | 8–20 hrs/week | Remote (EU/UK) Are you a senior procurement expert ready to leverage your real-world experience to shape the next generation of AI-driven procurement solutions? Do you have 8–20 hours per week available alongside your main job or consulting engagements? Join 10x Team and help AI systems understand and model effective procurement practices. About the Role 10x Team partners with leading AI labs to connect skilled freelancers with high-impact projects. We seek experienced procurement professionals based in the EU or UK who can improve the accuracy, depth, and practicality of AI-powered procurement models. About You - Senior-level procurement professional with extensive experience in the EU or UK. - Expertise advising on, designing, and executing sourcing strategies, contract negotiations, and procurement documentation. - Skilled at evaluating processes, technical requirements, and regulatory compliance. - Self-motivated and able to deliver structured, critical feedback independently. - Available 8–20 hours per week, with prompt communication. - You need to live in the UK or EU. Key Responsibilities: - Review and refine AI-generated content on procurement processes, sourcing, contract management, and regulatory topics. - Assess AI outputs for technical accuracy, practical application, and real-world compliance. - Draft realistic procurement scenarios inspired by your professional experience. - Develop scenario variations from diverse viewpoints (procurement manager, supplier, business stakeholder, auditor, etc.). - Identify gaps, oversights, or weak reasoning in AI-generated procurement materials. Put simply: You’ll use your procurement expertise to ensure AI-generated materials reflect authentic procurement logic, strategies, and supplier management methods. Your work empowers AI to learn complex procurement reasoning at scale. Why Join 10x Team? - Flexible, fully remote freelance assignments that fit your current workload. - Shape the future of AI by applying your procurement insights to cutting-edge projects. - Directly influence advanced AI procurement and supplier management systems. - Free access to our AI Academy to advance your AI know-how. - Transparent onboarding, clear briefs, and collaborative remote community. How to Apply: After applying, you’ll receive an email detailing the steps to: - ⁠Complete a short written assessment - Participate in an AI-powered interview Important: Your application is only complete once you finish all steps via the email link. Please note: these AI Lab missions are not traditional job openings with fixed start dates. Project demand is highly dynamic and matching depends on your expertise, availability, and current AI Lab needs. Some experts are matched within days, while others may wait longer for a suitable project. Take this opportunity to impact how AI learns expert procurement practices. Apply now and join us in building the world’s most advanced AI-driven procurement solutions! ----------------------------------------- NOTE At 10x, there are two types of opportunities: 1. Traditional freelance missions These are regular project-based opportunities where the listed mission is the actual project you may work on. 2. AI Lab roles For AI Lab roles, we scout, review, and approve profiles for access to future project opportunities. The missions listed for AI Lab roles are not traditional job openings. AI Lab work is often highly confidential as this exposes information of what an AI Lab is working on, and project requests are unpredictable. When an AI Lab request comes in, we often need to respond within 24 hours with suitable talent. Matching depends on the specific needs of each AI Lab project and your niche expertise. Once your profile is reviewed and approved, you may be matched to relevant AI Lab projects when suitable opportunities arise. This includes but not limited to: adjusting functional parts of devices and control instruments to sustain and improve operations; repairing or replacing defective parts; reconditioning or repairing machine tools. · Identifies needed parts, supplies, and repair items. · Provides support and back up for other members of department as needed by leadership. · Is aware of Maintenance Industry Standards. · Assures compliance with 5S and housekeeping standards. · Participates in CI activities - processes, results and cost savings. · May be required to setup and operate simple machining operations including but not limited to: lathe, drill press, grinder, and other metalworking tools to make and repair parts. jobgether-jobgether:lever:ee869283-574f-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data Governance Analyst based in United States. This is a fully remote opportunity to help shape data governance for a large-scale modernization program supporting federal courts nationwide. You will play a central role in establishing how data is defined, managed, protected, shared, and governed across complex environments. The position combines data governance, standards architecture, data quality, privacy, security, and compliance. You will collaborate with business, technical, legal, security, and data stakeholders to turn governance principles into practical processes and controls. Your work will strengthen data integrity, improve transparency, and enable more effective analytics and technology initiatives. The environment is highly collaborative, mission-focused, and centered on modern cloud-based data capabilities. This role offers the opportunity to influence governance maturity and build scalable practices within a major transformation program. Support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the data governance framework, including policies, standards, procedures, operating models, and governance roadmaps. Act as a Data Standards Architect by defining and maintaining data standards, naming conventions, business definitions, structures, reference data, and governance requirements across systems and teams. Establish clear data ownership, stewardship, accountability, and decision-rights models, including RACI frameworks across business and technical stakeholders. Partner with data stewards, data owners, business teams, security, privacy, legal, records management, and engineering teams to operationalize governance requirements. Ensure data is appropriately classified and managed according to sensitivity, criticality, business value, privacy, security, retention, and regulatory requirements. Translate policies and regulatory obligations into actionable governance controls, procedures, and data management practices. Identify governance gaps, data risks, and compliance issues, coordinating remediation efforts and tracking progress through resolution. Support data access, sharing, usage, lifecycle, and privacy governance processes across the organization. Participate in governance councils, working groups, data domain forums, assessments, audits, and compliance reviews. Develop and maintain governance documentation, standards, procedures, decision logs, training materials, and other supporting artifacts. Monitor adoption and effectiveness of governance policies and standards, reporting program metrics, maturity, risks, and compliance status to leadership. Support data quality profiling, monitoring, and improvement initiatives, helping ensure reliable and consistent enterprise data. Contribute to maturity assessments, continuous improvement initiatives, and the evolution of the data governance operating model. Deliver training and awareness sessions that help stakeholders understand governance policies, standards, responsibilities, and regulatory expectations. Requirements: Master's degree in Information Systems or a related discipline with 5+ years of general experience and 7+ years of specialized experience, or equivalent relevant experience. Demonstrated experience supporting enterprise data governance programs and translating governance policies into practical operational processes. Strong understanding of data quality management, metadata practices, data stewardship, governance frameworks, and operating models. Experience defining and governing enterprise-wide data standards across multiple teams, systems, or delivery environments. Experience working with high-sensitivity, regulated, or otherwise tightly controlled data and implementing appropriate privacy and security practices. jobgether-jobgether:lever:f99f263a-cdca-.title: Sr. UI/UX Designer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:f99f263a-cdca-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. UI/UX Designer based in Brazil. This is a senior design role focused on creating intuitive, polished, and engaging digital experiences across web and mobile products. You’ll work at the intersection of creative design and technical execution, partnering closely with developers and creative teams. The role offers ownership from early concepts and user flows through high-fidelity designs and interactive prototypes. You’ll bring strong visual design fundamentals while considering usability, responsiveness, accessibility, and how products are actually built. AI-powered design tools will be part of the workflow, helping you explore ideas and prototype quickly without compromising quality. You’ll have the opportunity to work on conventional and experimental digital experiences, with room to contribute creative ideas and new approaches. This is a fully remote position requiring strong communication, autonomy, attention to detail, and availability during AEST working hours. Design intuitive, high-quality user interfaces and experiences for web and mobile products, balancing usability, aesthetics, and technical feasibility. Translate briefs, business objectives, and product requirements into user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity designs, and polished digital experiences. Develop interactive prototypes in Figma that effectively communicate user behaviour, interactions, transitions, and overall product experience. Establish and maintain strong visual design systems, applying disciplined grids, spacing, typography, hierarchy, and responsive layouts. Use AI-powered design and creative tools to accelerate ideation, exploration, and rapid prototyping while maintaining a high standard of design quality. Collaborate closely with developers and technical teams throughout the design process to ensure accurate and practical implementation. Present design concepts and decisions clearly to colleagues, clients, and stakeholders, incorporating feedback while confidently explaining design rationale. Take ownership of projects from initial concept through final delivery, identifying problems and developing thoughtful, creative solutions. Help structure and organise design work, documentation, and workflows so projects progress efficiently across distributed teams. Contribute to experimental and innovative digital experiences, including immersive websites, animations, micro-interactions, and other emerging design approaches where relevant. Requirements: 5+ years of professional experience in UI/UX Design, Product Design, Digital Design, or a comparable senior design position. A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent UI/UX capabilities, visual design quality, and creative range, particularly across web experiences. Advanced proficiency in Figma, including interactive prototyping and the ability to communicate complex interactions effectively. Strong understanding of UI/UX principles, usability, information architecture and hierarchy, responsive design, and accessibility fundamentals. Excellent visual design skills, with a deliberate and consistent approach to grids, spacing, typography, composition, and layout. Proven experience collaborating closely with developers or other technical teams and understanding the practical considerations involved in implementation. Ability to take an idea from an initial concept or rough brief through user flows, design exploration, prototyping, and a polished final experience. Strong creative problem-solving skills, curiosity, and the ability to challenge conventional approaches when appropriate. Excellent written and verbal English, with confidence presenting designs and articulating the reasoning behind design decisions. Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and collaborate effectively within a fully remote environment. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is a plus,

strategichr-strategichr:greenhouse:79063.title: Field Service Controls Engineer
strategichr-strategichr:greenhouse:79063.description: Job Opportunity: Field Service Controls Engineer with Fameccanica North America in West Chester, OH Ready to launch your career in automation, controls, and robotics? Fameccanica North America is seeking an entry-level Field Service Controls Engineer to join its growing team. This is an onsite, hands-on role focused on testing, validating, troubleshooting, and supporting automated manufacturing equipment. In the beginning, this role will focus heavily on equipment testing and validation in Fameccanica’s West Chester facility. The work will be repetitive by design and will involve following test procedures, troubleshooting issues, documenting results, and helping ensure equipment is ready before shipment. As skills develop, this role may grow into customer-site support, installation, commissioning, and field service responsibilities. If you enjoy hands-on technical work, solving problems, and learning how automated equipment works from the ground up, this could be a great opportunity to grow your career. What You’ll Do: Test and validate automated equipment, including conveyors, sensors, electrical components, and controls. Follow checklists and test procedures to confirm equipment is operating properly. Troubleshoot basic PLC, HMI, electrical, pneumatic, and mechanical issues. Document testing results, service activity, and technical findings. Support equipment commissioning and customer requirements. Work alongside experienced engineers while learning Fameccanica systems. Eventually support customer sites as responsibilities grow. What We’re Looking For: Associate degree, technical certification, or related training in Robotics, Mechatronics, Industrial Automation, Electrical Engineering Technology, or a similar field. Strong mechanical and electrical aptitude. Interest in PLCs, controls, robotics, automation, or manufacturing equipment. Strong desire to learn, grow, and build a long-term career in automation and field service. Ability to follow processes, complete documentation, and troubleshoot problems. Professional, calm, and customer-focused communication style. Ability to work independently once trained while also being a strong team player. Work Authorization & Travel Requirements: Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Sponsorship is not available for this position. This is an onsite role based in West Chester, OH. Valid driver’s license required. Ability to obtain and maintain a valid U.S. passport. Travel may increase over time as skills develop and responsibilities grow, potentially up to approximately 70%. Why Fameccanica? Learn automation, controls, robotics, and manufacturing systems from experienced engineers. Join a growing global manufacturing and automation company. Build a long-term career path from hands-on testing into field service and commissioning. Gain exposure to advanced equipment, customer projects, and real-world troubleshooting. About Us: Fameccanica North America is a leader in industrial automation, dedicated to the design, development and manufacture of technologies, products, and services. Through our constant research and innovation activities, we aim at improving industrial processes and production for our customers. Talent applied to industrial innovation develops into care and attention: we find sustainable solutions for the benefit of our clients, consumers, and employees. Our idea of innovation starts from the present but looks to the future, in order to best meet tomorrow's challenges. Apply online today! #ZR
